statement: Source inspection does not establish exact Xbox Series device-side USB descriptors, initialization response timing, maximum ACK latency, keep-alive behavior, headset attachment transitions, four-motor physical actuation, or wireless receiver packet behavior on hardware. These remain test proposals rather than device evidence.

applicability.revision: Standard Xbox Series; physical firmware revision not available
applicability.scope: Unmeasured physical-device boundaries related to xbox-series-usb-device-gaps; all xone-specific evidence remains consumer-only. This record does not supersede the existing device-side gap claim.
